About our client

Our client is a well known international manufacturer with a premium brand and a long established reputation for quality. They supply trade and business customers across the UK, and their UK head office in Warwick is looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join a settled, close knit customer care team where people tend to stay.

Why this role is different

This is not a scripted call centre job. As a Customer Service Advisor you will be the person customers rely on to get things sorted, with the systems, training and support to do it properly.

No two days are the same. One call might be a trade customer tracking down the right spare part, the next a distributor chasing an urgent delivery, and the next a warranty query that needs some detective work. You will look after your own accounts, so you will get to know your customers and build real relationships rather than working through a faceless queue.

Product knowledge comes with time and support from the team. What matters is strong customer service experience, a curious mind and a genuine enjoyment of solving problems.

What you ll be doing
- Handling customer service calls, emails and tickets, with live chat on the way
- Helping customers identify products, product codes, spare parts and compatibility
- Owning your own accounts, processing orders accurately on SAP and keeping customers updated through to delivery
- Dealing with queries on availability, pricing and deliveries
- Being the first line of support for warranty, quality and spares queries, resolving them first time where you can and escalating complex cases to the Customer Care Team Leader
- Sending out product information, completing product registrations and keeping customer records accurate
- Working with internal teams and external partners to close investigations quickly
- Putting forward ideas to improve the customer service process

What we re looking for
- Solid office based customer service experience, such as B2 B, order processing, trade counter, aftersales or contact centre
- SAP experience is a big plus, and a similar ERP or order processing system will be considered
- Confident on the phone and clear and professional in writing
- Comfortable juggling several queries at once
- Good with Excel, Word and Outlook, and quick to pick up new systems
- Dependable and committed, someone the team can count on
- A good standard of education, such as GCSEs or equivalent

Location

Warwick, easy to reach from Leamington Spa, Kenilworth, Coventry, Stratford upon Avon, Southam, Rugby and Banbury, with quick access to the M40.

- Accuracy and compliance of document classification and version control
